input.quote: 13.5 SFJ Representation, Warranty and Covenant. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder.
input.rationale: SFJ performs real work for PB — the "SFJ Services" (global CRO oversight and execution of the Clinical Trials in the European Clinical Trial Countries, Japan and China) plus primary responsibility for the Phase 3 Trial in the Designated Asian Countries — yet the only SFJ-specific warranty in Article 13 is the funding warranty in 13.5. The nearest performance standards are covenants only: 3.1.4 (material compliance with Applicable Laws) and 3.1.5 (Commercially Reasonable Efforts to conduct the Clinical Trials in accordance with the SFJ SOPs). There is no express warranty of workmanlike performance or conformance, and no warranty remedy, so the clause fails even the fallback (which still requires a conformance warranty with repair/re-perform/refund). The exposure is compounded by 13.6.2, whose all-caps disclaimer carves out only what is "SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE 13", leaving nothing in Article 13 to stand behind SFJ's performance. We therefore inserted the warranty into Section 13.5 itself so it automatically falls inside the 13.6.2 carve-out (no separate change to the disclaimer needed), tailored to the services actually rendered (SFJ SOPs, Protocol, Applicable Law including GCP/ICH) with re-performance at SFJ's cost, and excluded from Development Costs so PB does not fund the fix. No fixed months-long warranty period is proposed because the obligations are continuous trial-conduct obligations rather than a delivered deliverable.

proposal.summary: Add an SFJ performance warranty for the SFJ Services (workmanlike standard, SOPs/Protocol/Applicable Law including GCP and ICH) with a re-performance remedy at SFJ's cost.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ conducts the Clinical Trials in the SFJ Territory and provides CRO oversight, but Article 13 gives us no performance warranty for that work and Section 13.6.2 disclaims everything outside Article 13. We have added, inside Section 13.5 so that it sits within the 13.6.2 carve-out, a warranty that the SFJ Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and in accordance with the SFJ SOPs, the Protocol and Applicable Law (including GCP/ICH), with re-performance at SFJ's cost as our remedy.

ops.newText: 13.5 SFJ Representations, Warranties and Covenants. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that (a) it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder; and (b) the SFJ Services and all other Clinical Trials activities conducted by SFJ or its Permitted Third Parties will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards and in accordance with the SFJ SOPs, the applicable Protocol and all Applicable Laws (including GCP and ICH guidelines). In the event of any breach of the warranty in clause (b), SFJ will, promptly following notice from PB, re-perform the affected activities in conformance with such warranty at SFJ's sole cost and expense, and such costs shall not be included in Development Costs; the foregoing remedy is in addition to, and not in lieu of, any other remedies available to PB under this Agreement.
